mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand environment, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS shows a sustained 3-month decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% each within two months signals a strengthening demand environment, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 2% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 2% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within a month signals an easing monetary policy, which leads to reduced borrowing costs and increased corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and a simultaneous decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% signals a robust economic expansion, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% within three months.
